en: A monochrome postcard view of an ornate pedestrian bridge leading through a decorative wrought‑iron gate flanked by stone pillars into a tree‑lined park. Three figures walk away from the viewer toward buildings visible beyond the gate. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the entrance to Valkhof in Nijmegen. Printer and copyright information are also printed along the lower margin.
